en: Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a tree-lined street in a spa town with several elegant late-19th/early-20th-century houses. The central building bears the name 'MOZART' above a balcony, while another building is labeled 'GERDA'. The caption at the top reads 'Bad Elster. Haus Weiße Rose u. Mozart'. Power poles and a sloping road with a few pedestrians are visible, giving a small-town Central European atmosphere.
